name: Timezone Converter
summary: Convert a date and time across world timezones — DST-aware, entirely in your browser.
description: Pick a wall-clock time and source timezone, then see it in cities worldwide. Uses the IANA timezone database via your browser’s Intl API, so daylight saving transitions are handled correctly.

faqs.question: How is DST handled?
faqs.answer: Conversions use your browser’s IANA timezone data through Intl, so daylight saving offsets are applied for the selected date.

faqs.question: What does “Source timezone” mean?
faqs.answer: The date & time you enter is interpreted as local wall time in that zone, then shown in every selected target zone.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
